description_en: Retrieves the list of resource categories
kebab_example: aliyun bdrc list-resource-categories --max-results 10 --next-token cae0000000000699 --resource-category-id rc-12300007890 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceCategories

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. As long as this parameter returns data, there is a next page. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to retrieve the next page of data until the return value is Null, which indicates that all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标，如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。说明 该参数只要返回数据，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到返回为Null，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource category ID. Optional. If specified, only the specified resource category is queried. If not specified, all resource categories are queried
parameters.help_zh: 资源分类ID。可选。填写后仅查询指定资源分类，不填则查询全部资源分类
parameters.name: resource_category_id
